messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible consistent with individual treatment goals"
set: ["use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible consistent with individual treatment goals", "duration should be consistent with individual patient treatment goals", "use lowest dose possible for shortest time needed", "use the lowest effective dose for your condition", "dose should be used for the shortest duration", "use the lowest dose for the shortest amount of time needed to treat your condition", "use the lowest dose that is effective in treating your condition", "people with asthma or other breathing problems at the lowest possible dose", "treatment duration", "lowest effective dose should be used", "adjust to the minimum effective dose", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "consider duration of treatment", "review should determine the appropriate dose for such treatment", "effective contraception during treatment", "use the dropper that comes with the concentrated solution"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible consistent with individual treatment goals",
    "use lowest dose possible for shortest time needed",
    "use the lowest effective dose for your condition",
    "use the lowest dose for the shortest amount of time needed to treat your condition",
    "use the lowest dose that is effective in treating your condition",
    "lowest effective dose should be used",
    "adjust to the minimum effective dose"
  ],
  "alias": "use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration possible consistent with individual treatment goals"
}
